description: Source code for the class 'ColumnarRow' which provides a row abstraction over a ColumnVector in Spark SQL's vectorized execution engine.

classes.name: ColumnarRow
classes.description: A class that provides a row interface over a ColumnVector, supporting data retrieval and copying.

methods.name: numFields
methods.description: Returns the number of fields in the row.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the row, used mainly in test paths.

methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; not implemented.

methods.description: Checks if the value at the given ordinal is null.
